thread:
raj: Heads-up: two pilots (one EMEA, one APAC) want deterministic per-request regional routing + tenant-scoped caching to beat Competitor X's edge story. Need product call: quick ship vs larger Private feature.

nina: Can you share the concrete asks?

raj: Short: 1) ability to prefer regional execution via header or tenant tag, 2) tenant-local prefix cache with configurable TTL, 3) a clear price uplift and pilot SLA (latency p50 target ~40-70ms in-region for small chat, p99 < 220ms).

olivia: Product POV: this is a high-signal commercial ask but narrow. Two choices: a) EdgeBridge Lite (routing + tenant cache + paid pilot add-on) in ~2 sprints, b) Elevate to Private roadmap (VPC + customer KV + formal SLA) which is months.

mark: Eng note: we can implement routing rules and a tenant cache layer as a routing-layer feature. Risk: cache divergence and invalidation complexity. Estimate: spike 3 days, implementation 2 sprints with one engineer pair.

jin: Ops: need per-tenant visibility. Also need a rollback hook if global tail latency increases. Can't accept a silent tail regression.

sarah: Sales: both pilots will sign a short-term paid pilot if we can promise region-prefer and a modest latency SLA. They expect a predictable pricing uplift (we should propose per-token + fixed pilot fee).

ops-bot: Deploy note: will require a routing flag in configstore and per-tenant dashboard tile.

raj: Suggested Launch criteria for EdgeBridge Lite pilot: p50 in-region <= 70ms on representative traffic, p99 <= 220ms, cache-hit rate >= 35% for chat prefix window, no more than 1% increase to global p99 for 24 hours post-rollout, pilot pricing doc versioned.

nina: Commercial ask: pilot SLA must be explicit. For pilots we can include a 5% credit for missed latency SLOs capped at pilot fee. Not full enterprise SLA.

olivia: UX/API: add header X-Redwood-Prefer-Region: ap-southeast-1 or tenant routing tag `region_prefer: true`. Expose cache controls: `cache_ttl_ms` per-tenant (default 30000). We'll need docs and an example curl.

mark: Implementation details: routing lookup order -> tenant tag -> header -> default region. Tenant cache lives on routing node with namespace `tenant:<id>:prefixcache`. TTL param. Auth: reuse routing-service service token. Minimal impact path for non-participants.

jin: Rollout plan: beta flag off by default -> enable for named pilot tenants -> watch 72h -> expand. Automation: detect p99 spike > 10% and auto-disable flag for affected shard.

sarah: Ask for metrics we need to show sales: per-tenant hit rate, per-tenant cost delta, effective latency tail. We'll provide a one-pager pricing recommendation.

eval-bot: Quick eval: Competitor X advertises sub-50ms p50 but logs show p99 spikes and frequent cold starts. If we focus on tail stability and predictable pricing this could be a differentiator.

raj: Decision: proceed with spike for EdgeBridge Lite. Nina + Mark to own spike; Oliva + Sarah to draft pilot commercial terms. Spike outputs due Thu COB. If spike cannot meet p99 stabilization requirement, escalate to Private roadmap justification.

nina: I'll book a 30m review Thu 4pm. Spike plan: synthetic replay + one-hour real traffic window from pilot tenant. We'll capture hit-rate breakdown by prefix length.

mark: I'll add a small telemetry patch to routing service to emit `tenant_cache.hit` and `tenant_cache.eviction`.

olivia: I'll prepare the pilot one-pager and suggested pricing band. Sarah, can you draft the pilot MSA addendum?

sarah: On it.

raj: Thanks everyone. Keep the thread updated. :rocket:
